alt: Real ChatGPT /exam execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /exam Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-question practice exam on training, inference and context. Include answer fields, revealable model answers and self-assessment scores. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Write a partial answer that distinguishes parameter updates from inference.
Reveal the model answer and inspect the missing reasoning.
Award 1 point because the answer meets one of the two rubric criteria.
Move to the question about learning from a new prompt definition.
Explain that the new definition changes context without proving weight updates.
Reveal the model answer and compare both rubric criteria.
Award 2 points for an answer addressing both criteria.
Explain how retrieval supplies context without guaranteeing correctness.
Reveal the model answer for the retrieval question.
Award 2 points for distinguishing retrieval from training and its reliability limit.
Inspect the complete self-assessed result of 5/6.
Restart the exam to clear the three answers and scores.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
